Sandbox Boot Sequence

Product·by @jeetnirnejak·2026-09-01·inspora page·original post

What it is

Sandbox boot checklist card: steps (Allocate microVM, Restore snapshot, Mount ephemeral FS, Boot runtime, Execute main.js, Reclaim sandbox) check off sequentially with per-step ms timings, top progress bar, streaming log lines, Booting->Running->Done status flip and a Re-run button; second pass runs 'Warm' with cached steps marked.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Card 'Sandbox node26', status Booting; first steps check green one by one (120ms, 35ms...), active step row highlighted mint with a spinner; footer 'Provisioning...'.
15-35%
Boot runtime step active (longer, ~1100ms); progress bar at top advances; per-step timing labels appear right-aligned.
35-55%
Execute main.js running; log panel streams lines ('$ node main.js', 'fetching dataset... 2.0 MB', 'compiled 1.9K rows', 'done in 523ms').
55-70%
All steps green incl. Reclaim sandbox; status flips Done; footer shows 'Exited 0 - 2200ms' and a black 'Re-run (warm)' button.
70-90%
Second run starts in Warm mode: header shows 'Warm - Running'; cached steps get 'cached' chips and complete near-instantly (timings like 12ms).
90-100%
Warm run completes much faster ('Exited 0 - 1500ms'); loop.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a sandbox boot checklist card. Steps (Allocate microVM, Restore snapshot, Mount ephemeral FS, Boot runtime, Execute main.js, Reclaim sandbox) check off sequentially with per-step millisecond timings, a top progress bar, streaming log lines, and a Booting -> Running -> Done status flip. A Re-run button triggers a second "Warm" pass where cached steps complete near-instantly.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark card "Sandbox node26" with status pill (Booting amber / Running blue / Done green). Top: 2px progress track. Checklist rows: step icon, label, right-aligned mono ms timing. States per row: pending (zinc-600), active (mint highlight + spinner), done (green check), cached (grey "cached" chip). Log panel: mono 12px lines ("$ node main.js", "fetching dataset... 2.0 MB", "compiled 1.9K rows", "done in 523ms"). Footer: status text ("Provisioning...", "Exited 0 - 2200ms") + black "Re-run (warm)" button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: autoplay scripted run + warm re-run.
- Cold run ~4.5s total: quick steps check off at 120ms / 35ms pace; Boot runtime holds ~1100ms; check draws in with a small spring pop (scale 0.6 -> 1, stiffness 400 damping 20, 200ms).
- Progress bar: scaleX origin-left advances with completed steps, 200-300ms ease-out per step.
- Log lines append during Execute main.js: one per ~350ms, each entering opacity 0 -> 1, y 4 -> 0, 200ms.
- Status pill crossfades text+color 200ms at each flip.
- Warm run ~2s: header reads "Warm - Running"; cached steps flash "cached" chips and complete at ~12ms; footer ends "Exited 0 - 1500ms".

## Calibration
- Step transitions 200-300ms; the ONE long step (Boot runtime, ~1100ms) is what makes the timings believable.
- The warm run must feel dramatically faster (~2s vs ~4.5s) - that contrast is the story.
- Mono + tabular-nums for every ms label; timings right-aligned in a fixed column.

## Reduced motion
Rows flip state with opacity only, 150ms; no check pop. Progress bar steps instantly.

## Don't miss
- Per-step timings appear as each step completes, not pre-rendered.
- The active row highlight is mint, not grey - it reads as "current" across the dark UI.
- "Exited 0" footer copy and the Re-run (warm) button are what make it feel like a real terminal.
